System & Drivers

System & Drivers apps for Omarchy

24 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-20 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 24 system & drivers packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-20.

Every system & drivers package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • asdcontrol omarchy pkg add asdcontrol
    Command-line brightness control for Apple's Thunderbolt displays, on Linux.
  • dell-xps-touchpad-haptics omarchy pkg add dell-xps-touchpad-haptics
    Dials in the click feel of Dell XPS haptic touchpads under Omarchy.
  • intel-ipu7-camera omarchy pkg add intel-ipu7-camera
    Gets the built-in webcam working on Intel Hurrican/Performance laptops.
  • lib32-nvidia-580xx-utils omarchy pkg add lib32-nvidia-580xx-utils
    32-bit helper tools and libraries for NVIDIA's 580-series Linux driver.
  • lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx omarchy pkg add lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx
    32-bit OpenCL support for NVIDIA GPUs on the 580-series driver.
  • libfprint-git omarchy pkg add libfprint-git
    The library that lets Linux talk to your fingerprint reader.
  • limine-mkinitcpio-hook omarchy pkg add limine-mkinitcpio-hook
    Keeps Limine's boot menu in sync every time you install a kernel.
  • limine-snapper-sync omarchy pkg add limine-snapper-sync
    Turns every Btrfs snapshot into a bootable Limine menu entry.
  • link-studio omarchy pkg add link-studio
    A native Linux control panel for your Insta360 Link webcam.
  • macbook12-spi-driver-dkms omarchy pkg add macbook12-spi-driver-dkms
    Kernel driver that brings the keyboard, trackpad, Touch Bar, and light sensor of newer MacBooks to Linux.
  • macbook8-spi-pxa2xx-nodma-dkms omarchy pkg add macbook8-spi-pxa2xx-nodma-dkms
    A patched SPI driver that forces PIO mode so the 2015 MacBook's touchpad and keyboard work reliably on Linux.
  • makima-bin omarchy pkg add makima-bin
    A background daemon that remaps keys, buttons, and macros for any keyboard, mouse, or controller on Linux.
  • nvidia-580xx-dkms omarchy pkg add nvidia-580xx-dkms
    Kernel module sources so your Linux kernel can talk to your NVIDIA GPU.
  • nvidia-580xx-utils omarchy pkg add nvidia-580xx-utils
    The user-space libraries and tools that make the NVIDIA 580xx driver actually usable.
  • omarchy omarchy pkg add omarchy
    An opinionated Arch Linux desktop, pre-wired for keyboard-driven, agentic workflows.
  • omarchy-audio-tuner omarchy pkg add omarchy-audio-tuner
    A measurement toolkit for building custom laptop-speaker EQ profiles on Linux.
  • omarchy-keyring omarchy pkg add omarchy-keyring
    The cryptographic keyring that lets pacman trust official Omarchy packages.
  • opencl-nvidia-580xx omarchy pkg add opencl-nvidia-580xx
    Lets NVIDIA GPUs crunch OpenCL workloads under the proprietary 580xx driver branch.
  • qmk-hid omarchy pkg add qmk-hid
    A driver-free command-line tool for talking to QMK keyboards over raw HID.
  • supergfxctl omarchy pkg add supergfxctl
    Switch your laptop between integrated and discrete GPU modes without rebooting into a different OS setup.
  • tuxedo-drivers-nocompatcheck-dkms omarchy pkg add tuxedo-drivers-nocompatcheck-dkms
    TUXEDO's laptop kernel drivers, with the model whitelist switched off so lookalike laptops can use them too.
  • v4l2-relayd omarchy pkg add v4l2-relayd
    Pipes any video source into a virtual webcam device.
  • xpadneo-dkms omarchy pkg add xpadneo-dkms
    Makes your Xbox wireless controller feel first-class on Linux, over Bluetooth.
  • yt6801-dkms omarchy pkg add yt6801-dkms
    The Linux driver that lets a Motorcomm YT6801 chip actually talk to your network.
